work_completed: Owner order (26/11/2026) recorded as ADD-0037 / DEC-0069: study of UX, colour, typography, inputs, panels, borders, motion and effects with contemporary references and community discussions (docs/design/estudo-visual-2026-11-26.md, sources linked).

Ecosystem visual language v1.0 (docs/design/linguagem-visual.md) with docs/design/tokens.json as the single authority of values: cool ink scale of 12 steps, violet (action/brand) and blue (information/selection), Inter + JetBrains Mono, 4-pt spacing, radii, elevation by tone, components (buttons, fields, selection, lists, sheets), motion tokens, effects budget, contrast WCAG AA + APCA floors, anti-patterns and review checklist; AGENTS.md §1.4 points every agent to it.

Lunet adopts v1.0: LunetTokens copied from tokens.json (version declared, test compares), Fluent palette and resource keys re-tinted for every stock control (fields without border and a 2 px violet focus ring, combo, switch, slider, checks, menus, tool tips, scroll bars), Inter embedded (Avalonia.Fonts.Inter) and JetBrains Mono embedded (OFL), buttons with press scale and colour transitions, primary = violet solid + white, secondary tonal without border, Selected kind for chosen options, cards and sheets without borders, shared Notice/Section/Field/Row components, labels outside fields in Versões, one primary per screen there.

Entry motion (§8): LunetUi.Enter (fade + rise with the enter curve; sheets 24 dp/300 ms, pages and Studios 16 dp/220 ms, scrims fade 150 ms), LunetUi.ReduceMotion honoured from Android's animator duration scale and used by the headless captures; test Motion_EntriesSettleVisible_AndReduceMotionSkipsThem.
PR #1049 merged before the visual-language commits; main was merged into the branch and they ship as 0.0.1-dev.1000606 in a new PR.

Showcase page in the portal (site/design/: index.html, design.css, design.js), requested by the owner: every token and component of the visual language demonstrated live — colour scales with WCAG and APCA computed in the page, type scale, spacing, radii, elevation, buttons (all kinds, sizes, loading), fields (label, hint, error, focus, search, select, number, textarea, disabled), switch, segmented, chips, slider, checks, list rows, tiles, card, phone mock with top bar and bottom nav, sheet, dialog, menu, toast, tooltip, states, empty and skeleton, notices, icon set, motion tokens, effects, anti-patterns and an interactive checklist; it reads tokens.json at runtime (copied by pages.yml), so the page never diverges; reduce-motion toggle and prefers-reduced-motion. Verified in Chromium (Playwright): no console errors, no horizontal scroll at 390 px.
